column1: One might expect the infirm and the indigent to talk to themselves, but one does not expect this behavior of an officer of the law.
column2: 一般人可能會預期病弱者或窮困者自言自語，但警察做出這種行為就不太尋常了。

column1: A typewritten notice: "Will whoever rear-ended my 1965 yellow Jaguar please come forward and admit it? Let's work out the insurance problems together. 555-7627."
column2: 一張打字通知：「哪位撞上我 1965 年黃色 Jaguar 的人，請出面承認？我們一起處理保險問題。555-7627。」

column1: You've already submitted one transfer request; there's no point in filling out another. If you did, they'd probably transfer you back again.
column2: 你已經提交過一份調職申請，再填一份也沒有意義。真這麼做的話，他們大概會把你調回原單位。

column1: This memo slot holds Transfer Request forms, Item #46471-32.
column2: 這個文件槽放著調職申請表，品號 #46471-32。

column1: You'd better leave the radio extender behind. If you get patted down, it could lead to blown cover and a premature ending to what you thought might be a promising career.
column2: 你最好把無線電延伸器留下。要是被搜身，臥底身分可能曝光，你以為前途光明的警察生涯也會提前結束。

column1: Officer Billings keeps batteries for the radios in here. Since he checks the extenders each morning, there's nothing of interest to you.
column2: Billings 警官把無線電電池放在這裡。既然他每天早上都會檢查延伸器，這裡沒有你感興趣的東西。

column1: You're a narcotics officer now. You don't need those squad car keys anymore.
column2: 你現在是緝毒警官，不再需要那些巡邏車鑰匙。

column1: Don't take a police radio extender undercover! If the find it on you, you're dead meat.
column2: 臥底時別帶警用無線電延伸器！要是被搜出來，你就完了。

column1: The side of the cabinet is scuffed, and the plastic paneling is starting to peel. The LPD budget being what it is, cosmetic appearance is considered unimportant.
column2: 櫃子側面滿是刮痕，塑膠面板也開始剝落。考量 LPD 的預算，外觀自然不重要。

column1: Sonny, if you're this coordinated on the firing range, remind me to be out of town the next time you go to practice!
column2: Sonny，如果你在靶場也這麼協調，下次你要練習時記得提醒我離開城裡！

column1: He doesn't need any help adjusting his uniform.
column2: 他不需要任何人幫忙整理制服。

column1: Ugh, wouldn't THAT be a horrible sight, ha ha! Later, Sonny.
column2: 呃，那畫面一定很可怕，哈哈！回頭見，Sonny。

column1: Shooting a mug shot wouldn't get you much beyond a suspension and bad publicity for the department.
column2: 拍自己的大頭照頂多讓你被停職，還會替警局招來壞名聲。

column1: The bulletin board has the usual array of mug shots and group activity announcements. Hey, is that Sergeant Dooley's mother?
column2: 公告欄上照例貼著一排大頭照和團體活動通知。嘿，那是 Dooley 警佐的母親嗎？

column1: Putting a mustache one of the wanted posters sure blows the professional image of a police officer. (It would have been fun, though...)
column2: 在通緝海報上畫鬍子肯定會破壞警察的專業形象。（不過應該滿好玩的……）

column1: The bulletin board doesn't want your money, Sonny.
column2: 公告欄不需要你的錢，Sonny。

column1: You don't have time to sit around now. Get out there and write some tickets.
column2: 你現在沒時間坐著閒晃。出去開幾張罰單吧。

column1: That would be completely out of character. You're an officer of the law, not a juvenile delinquent.
column2: 那完全不符合你的身分。你是執法人員，不是小混混。

column1: Don't be ludicrous. Pens are for writing on paper.
column2: 別胡鬧了。筆是拿來寫在紙上的。

column1: The chalkboard can't be bribed.
column2: 黑板不接受賄賂。

column1: Don't bother moving other people's chairs around, you've got your own spot to sit at during briefings.
column2: 別費心搬別人的椅子，你在簡報時有自己的座位。

column1: Standard departmental-issue seats, Item #42290-C.
column2: 標準部門配發座椅，品號 #42290-C。

column1: Stop tugging on Sgt. Dooley's sleeve. He's having a rough day.
column2: 別再拉 Dooley 警佐的袖子了。他今天已經夠倒楣了。

column1: Some first shift, huh, buddy!
column2: 這第一個班真精彩，對吧，老兄！

column1: You don't need to turn it off.
column2: 你不需要把它關掉。

column1: It's the light switch.
column2: 這是電燈開關。

column1: Kurt doesn't like being fingered.
column2: Kurt 不喜歡被人指指點點。

column1: It's Kurt, a good-natured officer.
column2: 這是 Kurt，一位性情溫和的警官。

column1: You close the paper, still grinning.
column2: 你闔上報紙，臉上仍帶著笑意。

column1: Always interested in your community, you pick up the newspaper.
column2: 你一向關心社區，於是拿起報紙。

column1: You don't have time to read the whole thing, Bonds.
column2: Bonds，你沒時間把整份報紙讀完。

column1: Steve's pigeonhole has a stack of subpoenas.
column2: Steve 的信箱裡放著一疊傳票。

column1: Not now!
column2: 現在不行！

column1: Hey! What's the idea, Bonds? Wake up!
column2: 嘿！你在想什麼，Bonds？醒醒！

column1: The tables definitely look like they've been around longer than the station itself. They were probably moved here from the old facility. Many a boring Dooley-led briefing has been endured here.
column2: 這些桌子看起來肯定比警局本身還老。它們大概是從舊設施搬來的。這裡不知熬過多少場 Dooley 主持的無聊簡報。

column1: Even if you COULD take Sgt. Dooley's room, where would you KEEP it?
column2: 就算你真的能把 Dooley 警佐的房間拿走，你要把它放在哪裡？

column1: You consider giving your dogs a rest, then decide you'd rather not be seen sitting at this particular desk.
column2: 你考慮讓雙腳休息一下，最後決定還是別被人看見坐在這張桌子前。

column1: If you were caught messing around in Dooley's desk, Dooley would mess around with your face...before sacking you. It's not worth it, and there's nothing in there you need.
column2: 要是你被抓到亂動 Dooley 的桌子，他會先把你的臉揍一頓，再把你開除。犯不著冒險，裡面也沒有你需要的東西。

column1: Did one of the eclairs just move? You wisely decide not to touch them.
column2: 剛才是不是有一個閃電泡芙動了？你明智地決定別碰它們。

column1: Something green and fuzzy is growing on the donuts.
column2: 甜甜圈上長出了綠色絨毛。

column1: I'd leave the Sergeant alone, if I were you.
column2: 如果我是你，就會讓警佐一個人待著。

column1: Sgt. Dooley has his hands full. While this chicken business seems to cross the line, you do get a secret satisfaction out of seeing Dooley this flustered.
column2: Dooley 警佐已經忙得不可開交。雖然這次的雞事件似乎太過火，但看到 Dooley 如此慌亂，你暗自感到滿意。

column1: Sgt. Dooley seems to be in a good mood. It's either good news, or he's about to lower the boom on somebody. You hope it isn't you.
column2: Dooley 警佐似乎心情不錯。不是有好消息，就是準備狠狠教訓某人。你希望那個人不是你。

column1: You don't think Seargent Dooley is in the mood for chit-chat right now.
column2: 你不認為 Dooley 警佐現在有心情閒聊。

column1: GET OUT!!!
column2: 出去！！！

column1: ...GET MOVING!!
column2: ……快動起來！！

column1: Now GET OUT!
column2: 現在出去！

column1: Do you want me to write you up, Bonds? Go do your job!
column2: 你想讓我記你一筆嗎，Bonds？去做你的工作！

column1: Is that any way for an officer of the law to behave? Leave the Sergeant's files alone.
column2: 執法人員該有這種行為嗎？別碰警佐的檔案。

column1: You don't want to ruin the ambiance of the room by making it a little cleaner, do you?
column2: 你不會想把房間打掃得乾淨一點，破壞這裡的氣氛吧？

column1: The papers all over the floor make the Sergeant's office decor complete.
column2: 散落滿地的文件讓警佐辦公室的布置更加完整。

column1: You have nothing to give Sgt. Dooley.
column2: 你沒有東西可以給 Dooley 警佐。

column1: You wonder if the Sergeant has looked in his in-basket in the past several months.
column2: 你懷疑警佐過去幾個月是否曾看過他的待辦文件籃。

column1: There's nothing you want to illuminate at the moment.
column2: 目前沒有什麼需要照亮的東西。

column1: It's Sgt. Dooley's desk lamp.
column2: 這是 Dooley 警佐的桌燈。

column1: You can't tell what it's saying. Sgt. Dooley isn't exactly holding it still. Perhaps you'd better take it from him.
column2: 你看不出上面寫了什麼。Dooley 警佐拿得一點也不穩。也許你最好從他手上拿過來。

column1: After getting a closer look, you decide you'd rather not touch Sgt. Dooley's outbasket.
column2: 仔細看過後，你決定還是別碰 Dooley 警佐的送件籃。

column1: It looks like no one wants to touch Sgt. Dooley's out-basket.
column2: 看來沒人想碰 Dooley 警佐的送件籃。

column1: You can imagine nothing more unsanitary than using Dooley's phone. You wisely decide against it.
column2: 你想不到比使用 Dooley 的電話更不衛生的事。你明智地打消念頭。

column1: Sgt. Dooley's telephone.
column2: Dooley 警佐的電話。

column1: Don't take the Sergeant's picture.
column2: 別拍警佐的照片。

column1: It's a lovely rendition of dogs playing poker.
column2: 這是一幅狗在玩撲克的可愛畫作。

column1: You reach for the pot, then decide that a stale cup of bad domestic coffee isn't worth risking electrocution for.
column2: 你伸手去拿咖啡壺，隨即決定一杯餿掉的廉價咖啡不值得冒觸電的風險。

column1: Sgt. Dooley's coffee pot. It looks like it hasn't been cleaned for months; Dooley hasn't even bothered to scrape the burnt coffee out of the bottom of the pot. How can he drink this stuff?
column2: Dooley 警佐的咖啡壺。看起來好幾個月沒洗過；Dooley 甚至懶得刮掉壺底燒焦的咖啡。他怎麼喝得下這種東西？

column1: OUT! OUT!! OUT!!!
column2: 出去！出去！！出去！！！

column1: Don't take that, it's the Sergeant's only hope.
column2: 別拿那個，那是警佐唯一的希望。

column1: It says, "Kiss me, I'm Irish".
column2: 上面寫著：「親我，我是愛爾蘭人」。
